item.title: Combustible waste in large volumes, 25th July
item.description:
This site used to be owned by the council but has been sold. I’ve no idea what is going on there now but the gardens behind the hoardings have got big piles of rubbish eg timber and garden waste throughout. It is so dry and if there is a fire it will be a disaster. Please get them to clean it up because we are all at risk in this hot dry weather. It is in the corner of Mount Adon park and upland Road and also along upland road section.

item.title: E-bikes and e-scooters plus normal bikes speed down footpath, 24th July
item.description:
The walk along the footpath on edge of Greenland Dock is routinely travelling fast into the path of pedestrians when they can ride on the road - Brunswick Quays and not disturb pedestrians. I am particularly concerned for elderly people and children walking or in prams. I think there is a need for bollards to slow them down and signs to state pedestrians only. Food delivery couriers are particularly impatient.
